description: This file contains mock class definitions for various interfaces related to display and connection properties used in testing. It includes mock classes for connection properties, HDR properties, display properties, and graphics properties, primarily using the Google Mock framework. The file also includes necessary headers and namespace usages, and defines mocks for notification interfaces.

classes.name: ConnectionPropertiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IConnectionProperties interface, providing mocked implementations for connection-related methods.

classes.name: ConnectionPropertiesNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IConnectionProperties::INotification interface, used for testing notification callbacks.

classes.name: HDRPropertiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IHDRProperties interface, providing mocked methods for HDR properties.

classes.name: DisplayPropertiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IDisplayProperties interface, providing mocked methods for display properties.

classes.name: GraphicsPropertiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IGraphicsProperties interface, providing mocked methods for graphics properties.
